The '''Irith system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Irith]]. In [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], it was [[Battle of the Irith system|conquered]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].
